imageSpecificText: Reuben, een herfstbraam (met stekels). Bred at the University of Arkansas, Reuben has been heralded as the first primocane blackberry - ie. it produces fruit on the current years growth. Not only that, but the fruits, which are produced in abundance, are the size of a plum (weighing up to 9g each). They have a glossy skin and sweet, slightly fruity-flavoured flesh and can be eaten straight from the bush, or used to make jams, pies or coulis.
